name: faulty-toolhead-4
title: Faulty Toolhead 4 Bypass
author: bespoked
description: Temporary recovery override for Snapmaker U1 error 0003-0523-0000-0002 when toolhead 4's thermistor is damaged and blocks boot. Remaps [extruder3] sensor_pin to e3:PC5, raises max_temp and drops max_power so the dead sensor is ignored, and neutralizes the e3_nozzle_fan nozzle fan. Do not heat or print with toolhead 4 while this is enabled; disable it once the part is replaced. Per-toolhead and independent, so several can be enabled at once.
tagline: Boot the U1 with a damaged toolhead 4 thermistor.
